heightProvenance.citation: Corlies et al. 2017, Titan's Topography and Shape at the End of the Cassini Mission, Geophysical Research Letters
heightProvenance.sourceProduct: topo_4PPD_interp.cub; Corlies archive 4 pixels/degree, 1440x720, float32 little-endian
heightProvenance.verticalDatum: height relative to a 2575 km spherical datum
heightProvenance.interpolation: Corlies radial-basis-function interpolation of sparse Cassini altimetry, SARtopo and stereophotogrammetry; global coverage does not imply global measurement
heightProvenance.sourceCoverage: approximately 9% of Titan area directly constrained according to Corlies et al.; broad interpolated regions should not be read as resolved local relief
heightProvenance.processing: Validated ISIS cube header and dimensions; sampled north-up east-positive grid with longitude seam wrap; bilinear resampling to 1024x512 and 2048x1024; uint16 little-endian at 0.05 m steps; JPEG appearance kept independent
heightProvenance.noData: Corlies interpolated grid contains finite values across the global raster; underlying sparse-measurement coverage remains explicitly qualified

source.citation: Weller et al., USGS 2026 controlled Titan ISS 938 nm global mosaic, 702 m; DOI 10.5066/P14FAEKS. Full-resolution PNG display derivative; sharpening baked into source, not true RGB/albedo.

imagery.normalization: Pixel-centered planetocentric east-positive -180..180 north-up; source GeoTIFF origin/resolution and label longitude direction explicitly sampled; no height inferred. Source grid is downsampled at most to 64 ppd; display contrast is not calibrated albedo.

heightPolicy: Scientific elevation only; resolution bounded by source; no image-derived relief. Enceladus NoData uses reference triaxial ellipsoid, Mercury NoData uses datum zero, Titan is a sparse-observation interpolation.

source.citation: Weller et al., USGS 2026 controlled Titan ISS 938 nm global mosaic, 702 m; DOI 10.5066/P14FAEKS. Full-resolution PNG display derivative; sharpening baked into source, not true RGB/albedo.

provenance.normalization: Pixel-centered planetocentric east-positive -180..180 north-up; source GeoTIFF origin/resolution and label longitude direction explicitly sampled; no height inferred. Source grid is downsampled at most to 64 ppd; display contrast is not calibrated albedo.

processing: Pixel-centered canonical east-positive imagery sampled bilinearly at native resolution (maximum 64 ppd); 512-pixel bounded JPEG tiles; 70-degree stereographic polar replacement, square equatorial ground spacing; little-endian uint16 scientific heights in lossless gzip. Polar imagery remains limited by native polar observations/fill.
